Betalbatim · a short walk from the Arabian Sea · working name

dumplings & draught

Food menu · Pan-Asian · cabin-style Chinese · dim sum & bao · Thai, Burmese & Korean

Pan-Asian, pub-style. Indo-Chinese the way the old Chinese cabins of the City of Joy cook it: high flame, double-fried, extra chilli. Hand-folded dim sum and soft bao. And a short run from Seoul to Bangkok: Korean wings, Thai curries and a Burmese khao suey. On most dishes you pick the protein. A few borrow from the Konkan pantry around us.
